A '''blade-breaker''' was a type of [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee]] [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]] used concurrently with a larger [[Vibro-weapon/Legends|vibroweapon]], such as a [[Vibrosword/Legends|vibrosword]]. It was equipped with a powerful ultrasonic generator in the hilt designed to shatter the material of an opponent's weapon trapped in the blade's grasp.
